notes: v431 — 🧪 The all-scans card grows a conscience. Every row now carries an evidence badge (SOLID / PROMISING / TOO EARLY) based on how many times it actually fired, and thin-evidence rows are dimmed and ranked last so a 6-fire fluke can never top the table. Edge is now shown for 5, 10 AND 20 days — slow signals that lose over a week but win over a month are no longer hidden — with buttons to rank by whichever window you care about. Plus a new 🧩 Combinations section: every pair of scans that flagged the same share the same day, graded, with each scan's solo edge alongside so you can see whether agreement actually beats one signal on its own. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5) to update.
